Research task: how do AI website builders onboard a brand-new user? I need CONCRETE, VERIFIED detail with citations (URLs). Use WebSearch and WebFetch extensively (official help centers, docs, 2025-2026 walkthroughs/reviews).

Cover these products — SECOND GROUP (you handle these three, plus one extra):
1. **Wix ADI** (Wix Artificial Design Intelligence) — note: check whether it still exists as a distinct product in 2026 or has been folded into "Wix AI website builder". Report what you find.
2. **Durable** (durable.co)
3. **Framer AI** (framer.com — "Start with AI"/Workshop)
4. **Hostinger Horizons / Website Builder AI** (as a bonus comparison point, only if time allows)

For EACH, answer precisely:
- What is the exact onboarding question sequence? List the questions in order (e.g. "what kind of site" -> "business name" -> "which features" -> ...). How many screens/steps before first generated output?
- Does it ask for style/colour/design direction, and how is that presented (theme cards? palette picker? adjective chips?)
- LOGO: can the user upload one? Does the builder generate a logo? What does it do with it (host it, extract palette from it, place it in the header)?
- REFERENCE URL: can you point it at a site you like? What does it do with it?
- IMPORT EXISTING SITE: can it pull in an existing website's content/branding? Wix and Durable both may have something here — verify.
- Does it scrape business data from anywhere (Google Business Profile, social profiles, existing domain)? This is important — Durable in particular reportedly pulls business info.
- Time-to-first-output claims made by the vendor (e.g. "30 seconds").

Rules:
- DO NOT invent or infer behaviour. If you cannot verify a point, write "UNVERIFIED" explicitly for that point. Reporting a gap is far better than guessing.
- Prefer official sources (support.wix.com, help.durable.co, framer.com/help) over affiliate review spam; if you must use a review site, say so and name it.
- Quote sparingly (under 15 words), cite a URL per claim.

Return a structured per-product writeup with the question sequences spelled out. Do NOT write any files.

content.thinking: I should note that Wix's ADI was discontinued in late 2024, replaced by the chat-based AI Website Builder and now the newer Harmony editor with Aria launched in early 2026 — so I need to account for two distinct current Wix AI paths when writing this up, and clearly flag anything unverified with its source.

content.text:
## 1. Wix ADI / Wix AI Website Builder / Wix Harmony

### Does ADI still exist in 2026? **No — confirmed dead.**
Wix's own help article states: "As of November 10th 2024, Wix no longer supports sites created using the ADI... builder." Published/active ADI sites now open in the Wix Editor instead; unpublished sites inactive for 6+ months were deleted. Wix names the **AI Website Builder** as the replacement.
Source: https://support.wix.com/en/article/adi-sites-no-longer-supported

**Important 2026 wrinkle:** on **21 January 2026** Wix launched **Wix Harmony**, a new editor with an AI agent called **Aria**. Wix's own help center has an article "About the New Wix Harmony Editor" describing it as released January 2026, with three entry paths — AI-generated ("describe your business and let Aria generate a full site with pages, sections and starter content"), Harmony-labelled templates, or drag-and-drop from scratch. The press release wording: "Start from a prompt, a template, or a blank canvas."
Sources: https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-the-new-wix-harmony-editor · https://www.wix.com/press-room/home/post/wix-launches-wix-harmony-the-ai-website-builder-that-merges-human-and-artificial-intelligence-rein · https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/01/21/3222826/0/en/Wix-Launches-Wix-Harmony-the-AI-Website-Builder-that-Merges-Human-and-Artificial-Intelligence-Reinventing-Web-Creation.html

So in 2026 there are **two live Wix AI paths**: the chat-questionnaire AI Website Builder (classic Editor) and Harmony/Aria (prompt-first). The question sequence below is the chat-questionnaire flow.

### Onboarding sequence (AI Website Builder, chat flow)

**Screen 0 — entry:** click *Create with AI* → sign up / log in → next screen offers three starting paths: AI Assistant, Start from scratch, Start from a Template. *(review source: makingthatwebsite.com/how-to-build-a-website-with-wix-ai/)*

**Screen 1 — "Start chat".** Wix's official article confirms the chat has four response controls: **"Help me answer"**, **"Skip question"**, **"End chat & continue"**, and Answer.
Source: https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-creating-an-ai-generated-site

**The questions themselves are adaptive, not fixed** — Wix's own docs do NOT publish the wording. The most concrete transcript I found is from **Website Builder Expert (review site)**, testing a video-game review site; it recorded four questions in this order:
1. "What's the name of your video game review site?"
2. "What type of content will you be featuring on [Site Name]?"
3. "What are your additional goals for [Site Name]? (For example, do you want to build a community or monetize your content?)"
4. "What would you say is your unique selling point for [Site Name]?"

That source explicitly notes the bot is reactive and asks different/extra questions by site type (e.g. audience or product questions for ecommerce).
Source: https://www.websitebuilderexpert.com/website-builders/how-use-wix-ai/

**Screens/steps before first output:** after the chat you click **"Design Site" → "Generate a Design"**. So roughly: entry → path choice → chat (≈4–5 turns) → Design Site → Generate. Post-generation controls per Wix docs: **Regenerate Design**, **Tweak Design**, **Edit the site brief** (site profile/description, site structure = page & section selection, **theme = colors/fonts**, layout).
Source: https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-creating-an-ai-generated-site

### Style / colour / design direction
**Not asked up front.** Design direction arrives *after* generation, as a **theme panel with "Generate new theme" and "Shuffle these colors"** (primary/secondary), plus "Generate new layout" / "Shuffle this layout." No adjective chips or theme cards at the questionnaire stage per official docs.
Source: https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-creating-an-ai-generated-site

*(One review, FireBear, claims the chat asks about "tone or style"; I could not corroborate this in Wix's own docs — treat as **weakly sourced**: https://firebearstudio.com/blog/wix-review-site-building-without-limits.html)*

### Logo
- **Upload: yes**, but as a separate editor action, not an onboarding step. Harmony's logo article gives three methods: **Create with Logo Maker**, **Upload Logo** (from Media Manager), **Replace Logo**. Source: https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-harmony-editor-adding-a-logo-to-your-site
- **Generation: yes**, via the separate **Wix AI Logo Maker / Wixel**, which Wix describes as creating logo designs "after asking questions about the business and style preferences." Sources: https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-wixs-ai-tools · https://support.wix.com/en/article/wixel-creating-a-logo-with-ai
- **Does the AI builder auto-place a generated logo during site generation, or extract a palette from an uploaded logo?** **UNVERIFIED** — the Harmony logo article makes no mention of AI auto-adding a logo, and no Wix doc I found describes palette extraction from a logo.

### Reference URL ("build me something like this site")
**UNVERIFIED.** No Wix official documentation found describing pointing the AI builder at a reference URL.

### Import existing site
**UNVERIFIED / likely no.** Wix's AI Tools overview page describes the AI Website Builder as creating new sites and lists no import tool. Targeted searches of support.wix.com surfaced no "import from URL" article for the AI builder.
Source: https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-wixs-ai-tools

### Business-data scraping (GBP, socials, domain)
**UNVERIFIED.** Nothing in Wix docs describes pulling from Google Business Profile or social profiles at creation time. (Harmony's docs say Aria personalizes "based on the site's details and business info" — i.e. info you gave it, not scraped.)

### Time-to-first-output claim
Wix's marketing page says a professional site "in seconds" and uses a 4-step framing (Describe your vision → Watch AI build → Make it yours → Publish and grow). The Harmony press release claims "the speed of AI generation" but gives **no specific number**. Website Builder Expert's hands-on says "under an hour" for a complete customized site and reports ~1 hour actual.
Sources: https://www.wix.com/ai-website-builder · https://www.websitebuilderexpert.com/website-builders/how-use-wix-ai/

---

## 2. Durable (durable.co → durable.com)

Note: durable.co now 301-redirects to **durable.com**, and the help center is **help.durable.com**. Durable relaunched as "the complete AI business builder" in a **17 March 2026** blog post.
Source: https://durable.com/blog/launch

### Onboarding sequence — the tightest of the four: **3 questions, one screen**
Durable's own product page says only: **"Answer 3 questions about your business."**
Source: https://durable.com/ai-website-builder

The three fields, in order (consistent across two independent hands-on reviews):
1. **"What type of business are you building?"** — pick from preset categories; free-text description also accepted (e.g. "a vegan café specialized in organic coffee")
2. **"What is the name of your business?"** — with an **optional AI business-name generator** if you don't have one
3. **"Where is your business located?"**
Plus an optional **language selection** (English, German, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish, Dutch, French).
Sources *(both review sites)*: https://www.makingthatwebsite.com/durable-ai-website-builder-review/ · https://www.fahimai.com/durable-ai-website-builder

**Steps before first output: 1 screen, then Generate.** No account required to generate and preview — sign-up is deferred until you want to claim the site. *(review: makingthatwebsite.com)*

### Style / colour / design direction
**Not asked at all.** Reviews are explicit that the AI picks it: "It will automatically select a layout, color palette, and relevant images" from business type alone. Restyling happens post-generation — Durable has a one-click **restyle** button that changes colors, fonts, text and image positions, plus premade palettes.
Sources *(review sites)*: https://www.makingthatwebsite.com/durable-ai-website-builder-review/ · https://www.websiteplanet.com/website-builders/durable/

### Logo
- **Generation: yes**, but as a **separate tool after site creation**, not in the 3-question flow. Durable ships an **AI Brand Builder** and an **AI Logo Generator** that produce logo, colour palette and font scheme; the logo is output in multiple formats (social profiles, printed merch) and the brand applies across invoices, forms and social images.
Sources: https://durable.com/ai-brand-builder · https://durable.co/ai-tools/logoai · https://www.websiteplanet.com/website-builders/durable/ · https://www.fahimai.com/durable-ai-website-builder
- **Upload your own logo:** **UNVERIFIED.** I could not reach a Durable help article confirming logo upload (the help center's 8621802/8646991 article URLs 404 on the new .com domain). One review notes users can "provide logo, color choices, and a headline" — but that's a secondary aggregator, not authoritative.
- **Palette extraction from an uploaded logo: UNVERIFIED** (no source found).

### Reference URL
**UNVERIFIED.** No source found offering "point at a site you like."

### Import existing site — **explicitly NO**
Durable's own FAQ (quoted in a review): "Not at this time. It is not possible to download the website content or import a file to upload it to the Durable website."
Source *(review quoting Durable FAQ)*: https://www.makingthatwebsite.com/durable-ai-website-builder-review/

### Business-data scraping — **YES, this is the real one**
Durable has a dedicated **Google Business Profile Website Builder**: you type your Google Business Profile into the generator and Durable builds the site from your Google profile information — a genuine alternative entry point to the 3-question flow.
Sources: https://www.websiteplanet.com/website-builders/durable/ (review, but quotes the product directly) · product page exists at `durable.com/google-business-profile-website-builder` (indexed via https://fr.durable.co/google-business-profile-website-builder — the page itself returned a Vercel login wall to my fetch, so **the exact field list and which GBP fields are pulled — hours, address, photos, reviews — is UNVERIFIED**)

Separately, post-creation Durable connects GBP on the **SEO & GEO** page for search/AI visibility, and can pull **existing Google reviews** onto the site.
Sources: https://durable.com/ (homepage references connecting a Google Business Profile) · https://help.durable.com/en/

Social profile scraping: **UNVERIFIED**.

### Time-to-first-output claim
Vendor headline: **"Create a Website in 30 Seconds"**, "generate a complete website in around 30 seconds", "faster than ordering coffee", and on the relaunch blog "from idea to live site in under 30 seconds."
Sources: https://durable.com/ai-website-builder · https://durable.com/blog/launch · https://durable.com/ ("Get online in 30 seconds")
Observed in hands-on reviews: **30–45 seconds** (makingthatwebsite, fahimai); "less than a minute" (websiteplanet).

---

## 3. Framer

### Big caveat on naming
Framer's AI entry point has been renamed at least twice. The original consumer-facing **"Start with AI"** (a new-project option) became **Wireframer**, and by 2026 Framer's own Academy course is titled **"Get Started with Framer Agents"** — the lesson formerly at `/academy/lessons/wireframer` now redirects into the Framer Agents course.
Sources: https://www.framer.com/academy/lessons/wireframer · https://www.framer.com/academy/lessons/framer-agents-generation-layout-style · https://www.framer.com/ai/

**"Workshop" is a different thing** — it is Framer's AI **component** builder (Cmd+K → "Workshop"), for logic-heavy components like calculators, forms, quizzes and countdown timers. It is *not* the site-onboarding flow. Best source is a review (oma-kase.com/blog/framer-ai-workshop-plugin); Framer's own /ai page describes it as "AI Code Components — build custom interactive features from descriptions."
Source: https://www.framer.com/ai/

### Onboarding sequence — **there is no question sequence. It's a single prompt box.**
Framer's own solutions page gives a 4-step framing:
1. **"Start from a prompt"** — "Describe the site, audience, or page you need, then let Framer AI generate a strong first direction." Entry points can be "a prompt, brief, blank canvas, or existing idea."
2. Refine the design visually on canvas (structure, copy, styling, sections, images, responsive behavior)
3. Add real site systems (CMS, SEO metadata, forms, analytics, components)
4. Publish and iterate
Source: https://www.framer.com/solutions/ai-website-builder/

Mechanically: new project → **Insert → Wireframer** (or Cmd+K), which opens a chat box. The box offers **preset templates** (e.g. "a personal page with a list of projects") or your own typed prompt. **One step to first output.**
Source *(Framer University — community/partner blog, not framer.com)*: https://framer.university/blog/the-new-ai-workflow-for-building-websites

Framer's Academy notes the prompt should be specific about subject and desired sections (navigation, feature section, testimonial, footer), and that Wireframer generates responsive sections with navigation, headings, image placeholders and AI-written body copy — **all breakpoints (desktop/tablet/mobile) generated simultaneously**.
Sources: https://www.framer.com/academy/lessons/wireframer · *(review)* https://hostadvice.com/ai-app-builders/framer-review/

### Style / colour / design direction
**No separate style step and no theme cards or adjective chips.** Style is expressed inside the prompt itself — Framer's own example prompt on /ai: *"Generate a homepage for Bloom... Make it minimalistic and dark, with releases, research themes, public trust, and CTAs."* A review notes the prompt box deliberately has no "AI Styles" settings.
Sources: https://www.framer.com/ai/ · *(review)* https://hostadvice.com/ai-app-builders/framer-review/

**Post-generation** you get shuffle-style controls: shuffle fonts and colour palettes, shuffle a specific section to randomize colours within it, AI text rewrite, AI translate. Framer's own /ai page also lists an **AI Site Review** (contrast issues, typos, alt-text gaps, SEO problems, style inconsistencies).
Sources: *(tutorial site)* https://designcode.io/framer-web-design-ai/ · https://www.framer.com/ai/

### Logo
- **Upload: yes**, but as normal post-generation editing — you replace placeholder images and upload your logo on canvas. *(Framer University: framer.university/blog/the-new-ai-workflow-for-building-websites)*
- **AI logo generation: UNVERIFIED** — Framer's /ai feature list includes AI image generation for visuals but no logo generator per se.
- **Palette extraction from a logo: UNVERIFIED.**

### Reference URL — **yes, this is Framer's differentiator**
Framer's own /ai page states the agents accept **"Upload images, files, or URLs to guide AI toward the exact result"**, plus canvas context (select layers and add them as chat context) and model selection (GPT, Sonnet, Opus, or Fable). The Academy lesson adds that agents can **rebuild UI from screenshots**.
Sources: https://www.framer.com/ai/ · https://www.framer.com/academy/lessons/framer-agents-generation-layout-style

**Caveat:** this is described as context for the *agent inside a project*, not as a first-screen "paste a URL to clone" field. Whether a URL can be supplied at the very first new-project prompt: **UNVERIFIED**.

### Import existing site
**UNVERIFIED / not documented.** Framer's own pages make no import claim; the URL-as-context capability above is the closest thing.

### Business-data scraping
**UNVERIFIED.** No GBP/social scraping documented.

### Time-to-first-output
Framer's own pages make **no numeric claim** — /solutions/ai-website-builder gives no time estimate. Third parties claim: "under 30 seconds" for a responsive copy-filled homepage *(hostadvice review)*, "30 seconds to one minute" for a full page layout *(designcode.io)*, and "from prompt to published site in minutes" *(Framer University)*.

---

## 4. Hostinger — two separate products, don't conflate them

### 4a. Hostinger AI Website Builder (the site builder)
**Onboarding fields, in order:**
1. **Brand name**
2. **Type of website** — a picker: Online store, Blog, Business, Portfolio, Landing page, Other
3. **Description** — free text, **max 700 characters including spaces**; Hostinger's guidance: "The more descriptive you are, the better results you'll get!"

Hostinger's marketing summarizes it as: you only need "a name, a website type, and a short description."
Sources: https://www.hostinger.com/blog/ai-website-builder-unique-websites · https://www.hostinger.com/ai-website-builder

**Time claim (vendor):** the AI prepares structure, layout and mobile view, generates content and picks images, and "your unique website will be ready in **less than a minute**."
Source: https://www.hostinger.com/blog/ai-website-builder-unique-websites

**Style/colour step, logo, reference URL, import:** **UNVERIFIED** — the official support article does not document any of these at onboarding.

### 4b. Hostinger Horizons (the web-app / vibe-coding builder)
**Flow per Hostinger's official support article:** pricing page → hPanel → Websites → Add Website → **AI Builder** → a text field where "you can write your prompt in more than 80 languages" (or select a template) → choose a domain or use a temporary one → split-pane view (prompts left, live preview right) → refine → Publish. Then a separate choice of **Manual** editing vs **Agentic** (conversational, consumes AI credits).
Sources: https://www.hostinger.com/support/how-to-create-a-web-app-using-hostinger-horizons/ · https://www.hostinger.com/support/7266945-how-to-use-hostinger-ai-website-builder/

**First screen (public site):** a single large box asking **"What would you like to build?"**; sign-up is requested *after* you enter your idea. *(review: cybernews.com/ai-tools/hostinger-horizons-review/)*

**Clarifying questions:** Hostinger's official prompting article confirms "some clarifying questions from Hostinger AI Builder may show clickable answer options" — i.e. **chip-style answers exist**. A **prompt-guidance planning agent** that asks targeted questions to auto-generate optimized prompts launched **January 2026**, alongside a select-and-edit visual editor and 100+ new templates. **The exact questions it asks are UNVERIFIED.**
Sources: https://www.hostinger.com/support/prompting-hostinger-horizons-build-your-web-app-effectively/ · *(review)* https://bloggingjoy.com/hosting/hostinger-horizons-review/

**Wireframes can be uploaded as prompts.** Logo upload/generation, reference URL, and site import: **UNVERIFIED / not mentioned in the creation flow.**
Source: https://www.hostinger.com/support/how-to-create-a-web-app-using-hostinger-horizons/

## Cross-product summary

| | Wix (AI Builder / Harmony) | Durable | Framer | Hostinger AI WB |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Input model** | Adaptive chat, ~4–5 Qs | 3 fixed fields, 1 screen | Single free prompt | 3 fields (name/type/description ≤700 chars) |
| **Steps to output** | entry → path → chat → Design Site → Generate | 1 screen → Generate | 1 prompt | 1 form |
| **Style asked up front** | No — theme panel after (shuffle colors, generate new theme) | No — AI picks palette; restyle button after | No — style lives in the prompt; shuffle after | UNVERIFIED |
| **Logo upload** | Yes (editor, not onboarding) | UNVERIFIED | Yes (post-gen canvas) | UNVERIFIED |
| **Logo generation** | Yes — separate Wixel / AI Logo Maker | Yes — separate AI Brand Builder | UNVERIFIED | UNVERIFIED |
| **Reference URL** | UNVERIFIED | UNVERIFIED | **Yes** — URLs/images/files/screenshots as agent context | UNVERIFIED |
